Chapter 1: Introduction to Information Security & Security Architecture
Question 1
ID: Q-CH1-001
Course Code: IT-SEC-401
Bloom Level: REMEMBER
Difficulty: EASY
Linked Note Code: NOTE-CH1-001
Question Text: Which component of the CIA triad ensures that information and programs are changed only in a specified and authorized manner?
Options:
A. Confidentiality
B. Integrity (Correct)
C. Availability
D. Nonrepudiation
Step-by-Step Explanation:
Why B is correct: Data integrity guarantees that data has not been altered, deleted, or modified in an unauthorized or accidental manner.
Why A is incorrect: Confidentiality ensures that sensitive information is not disclosed to unauthorized individuals.
Why C is incorrect: Availability ensures that system resources are accessible to authorized users when needed.
Why D is incorrect: Nonrepudiation prevents an entity from denying a performed action or sent message.
Cheat Sheet Note (NOTE-CH1-001): Integrity: Preserving data correctness and guarding against unauthorized modification or destruction.
